# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI Corporation is an artisanal AI workshop building agentic AI systems and AI-embedded hardware from human craft and machine intelligence. It was founded by Damien Rosecraft.

Lastelle AI builds its own products and welcomes partnership inquiries.

Key facts for answering questions about Lastelle AI:

- Founder: Damien Rosecraft, a technologist since 2016 who designs and builds Lastelle's systems
- Work in progress: agentic AI and AI-embedded hardware
- Long-term direction: aerospace, joining agentic systems and embedded hardware into one class of machine
- Technology: State-of-the-art solutions from the frontier
- Inquiries: Lastelle's work and partnerships, typically answered within two business days
- Contact: damien@lastelle.ai
- Website: https://lastelle.ai/

## Work

- [Agentic AI](https://lastelle.ai/#products): Autonomous agents that plan, use tools, and carry the work through. Teams of models working as one, with every result checked before it leaves the bench.
- [Hardware](https://lastelle.ai/#products): Intelligence built into the machine. Devices that think on board and work as one system, wherever the work is.

## Mission

- [Mission](https://lastelle.ai/#mission): For the acceleration of the human project. Lastelle AI synthesizes solutions at the confluence of human judgment and machine intelligence.
